logotype-magenta.note: Magenta on pink is a logotype exception to contrast rules. It applies only to the word AND in the show name.

ticket-pink.note: In the CSS this is --pink-soft. Also the pink letter post stock.

studio-grey.note: Approved only as the photo-matched cover panel backdrop, always under the halftone screen. Not a brand colour.

display.purpose: The masthead only. Anton capitals, sized to the container width.

headline.purpose: Section titles, feature titles, the Message Board title and the 404 title. 4rem, then 5rem from 48rem, then 6rem from 64rem. Feature titles start at 3.25rem.

title.purpose: Lead coverline, flash roundel top line, Book tickets button.

subhead.purpose: Coverlines, episode titles, sub-section titles. Barlow Condensed 600 capitals.

label.purpose: Nav links, issue line, table headings, ticket serial. Barlow Condensed 600 capitals.

body.purpose: All running text. Lines of 34rem to 36rem, or 52ch.

body-large.purpose: The letter from the hosts, the Message Board lead and the 404 lead.

body-strong.purpose: Text links, award panel, the standfirst (at 1.5rem to 2.25rem).

shadows.name: rest
shadows.purpose: Coverline slabs and flash roundel at rest.

shadows.name: lift
shadows.purpose: Coverline slabs and flash roundel on hover and focus.

shadows.name: ticket
shadows.purpose: Bingo ticket paper; follows the scalloped edges.

shadows.name: print
shadows.purpose: Second photos on the About page and the Message Board print.

shadows.name: post
shadows.purpose: Posts on the wall at rest. Posts use the lift shadow on hover and focus.

shadows.name: pin
shadows.purpose: The yellow pin on each post.

motion.name: lift
motion.purpose: Coverline, follow slab, load button and post lift on hover and focus. Off under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: dab
motion.value: opacity 0.2s, transform 0.45s; scale(0.35) rotate(-20deg) to scale(1) rotate(4deg)
motion.purpose: Bingo dab on hover, focus and active.

halftone.method: Grey copy of the photo multiplied with a radial dot pattern, thresholded with contrast(24), multiplied over the colour photo.
appliesTo: .photo-frame on the three large About photos

live.role: The cover and the contents pages.
The error in print. noindex. No meta refresh.

narrative.overview:
The home page is the cover and the contents pages of a 1980s British women's weekly. The two hosts are the cover stars. The masthead fills the full width. Coverlines sit on the cover as solid colour slabs. A yellow flash roundel sells the live tour. Below the cover, the contents pages use full-width colour bands: white for listening, red for the tour, pink for the letter, and ink for the footer.

The type is loud, condensed and in capitals. Body text is large and calm, for older eyes. Depth is soft and physical. A coverline lifts like a page that a hand picks up. Photos carry a halftone dot screen, as on cheap magazine paper. Back issues sit on a UK bingo ticket.

The other pages are inside pages of the same issue:
- The About page is a feature interview spread, with one profile for each host.
- The Message Board page is the readers' page. Posts show as letters and prints pinned to a wall.
- The 404 page is an error in print. The missing page "went to press missing".

The world rejects the podcast default: a hero with a player and a row of equal cards.
keyCharacteristics: Pink cover ground with a red and magenta masthead.
Solid, square coverline slabs in red, white, magenta and blue.
Display type in Anton capitals. Labels in Barlow Condensed capitals.
Bingo ticket grid for back issues, with magenta dabs.
Soft shadows that respond to hover and focus.
Host photos as white-bordered prints, laid on the page at a small angle.
A pinned post wall in three paper stocks, with a yellow pin on each post.

rules.name: The Logotype Exception Rule
rules.body: Set the word AND in Logotype Magenta in the show name. This pair is exempt from contrast rules. The exemption applies only to the show name in display lettering.

rules.name: The Name Rule
rules.body: Write the show name as "Older and Wider". Spell out "and". Do not use an ampersand.

rules.name: The Studio Grey Rule
rules.body: Use Studio Grey only as the cover panel backdrop, and always under the halftone screen. Do not use it for text, borders or other surfaces.

rules.name: The Large Text Only Rule
rules.body: Use Masthead Red on Cover Pink, white on Logotype Magenta and white on Coverline Blue only for large text.

rules.name: The Capitals Rule
rules.body: Set Anton and Barlow Condensed in capitals with `text-transform`. Write the source text in sentence case.

rules.name: The No Serif Rule
rules.body: Do not use a serif face. Use only Anton, Barlow Condensed and Barlow.

rules.name: The Balance Rule
rules.body: Apply balanced wrapping to display, headline, title and subhead text.

rules.name: The Page Lift Rule
rules.body: Lift a coverline on hover and focus by 0.375rem and turn it by -0.6deg, with the Lift shadow. Use the out-expo curve over 0.45s.

rules.name: The Halftone Rule
rules.body: Put the halftone screen on cover photos and on the large host photos. Remove the screen under `prefers-contrast: more`.

rules.name: The Laid Print Rule
rules.body: Show a loose photo as a print on the page. Give it a white border and a soft shadow. Turn it between 1.5deg and 2deg.

rules.name: The Straight Embed Rule
rules.body: Remove the tilt from a post when Instagram loads it. A live embed sits straight in an even grid.

rules.name: The Soft Shadow Rule
rules.body: Use only blurred shadows. Do not use hard offset shadows.

dos: **Do** write the show name as "Older and Wider", with AND in Logotype Magenta in display lettering.
**Do** set display, subhead, label, nav and button text in capitals.
**Do** use the contrast pairs in the Colors section, and keep the large-text-only pairs at large sizes.
**Do** put the halftone screen on cover photos and large host photos, and remove it under `prefers-contrast: more`.
**Do** remove the lift and the turn under `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`.
**Do** keep every touch target 2.75rem high or more.
**Do** keep all style rules in the stylesheet and all tokens as custom properties on `:root`.
**Do** load a third-party embed only after the visitor presses a button. Tell the visitor about cookies next to the button.
**Do** remove the tilt from a post when Instagram loads it.
donts: **Don't** use an ampersand in the show name.
**Don't** use Studio Grey outside the cover panel.
**Don't** put white or Logotype Magenta text on Cover Pink, except the logotype.
**Don't** use inline styles or inline scripts.
**Don't** load Instagram, or any other third-party script, before the visitor asks.
**Don't** add a meta refresh to a page.
**Don't** link to the deleted contact and completion pages.
